sn44.5:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye …pe…
sn44.5:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.5:1.4: rūpe kho āvuso avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.5:1.9: viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.5:1.15: viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatacchandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.16: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.5:1.17: ayaṃ kho āvuso hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
